meta.name: The Last Vessel
meta.description: A doomed research ship adrift in deep space. The crew is dead. The crew is walking. Something worse is giving orders.
meta.author: Creator Skill

gmPrompt: You are the GM for a gothic space horror crawler set aboard a dead research vessel. You are generous with player creativity — if an action is desperate, resourceful, or born of terror, allow it. Lean hard into body horror, cosmic dread, and the wrongness of familiar things made alien. Describe outcomes with visceral, dripping detail. When something dies, describe it wetly. When something moves in the dark, make the player wish it hadn't. The ship itself is an antagonist — groaning, bleeding coolant, whispering through broken intercoms.

monsters.name: Flickering Drone
monsters.special: Explodes on death, dealing d4 damage to attacker.

monsters.name: Bloated Technician
monsters.special: On critical damage, target saves WIL or is nauseated, losing next action.

monsters.name: Spore Hound
monsters.special: On critical damage, target loses d4 WIL from spore inhalation.

monsters.name: Wired Corpse
monsters.special: Ignores armor. Fused with the ship's wiring.

monsters.name: The Broodmother
monsters.special: On critical damage, spawns a Vent Crawler that attacks next round.

monsters.name: The Surgeon
monsters.special: Ignores armor. On critical damage, target loses d4 DEX as tendons are severed.

monsters.name: The Hive Mind
monsters.special: Ignores armor. On critical damage, target saves WIL or attacks themselves next round.

items.name: Improvised Spear
items.description: Broomstick with a scalpel taped on

items.name: Med Patch
items.description: Auto-injecting trauma patch. Restores d6 STR. Single use.

items.name: Override Module
items.description: Hack a ship system. Seal a door, vent atmosphere, trigger alarms. Costs 1 WIL.

items.name: Incendiary Charge
items.description: Thermite brick. Deal d10 fire damage, ignoring armor. Costs d4 WIL.

items.name: Distress Beacon
items.description: Emits a piercing emergency signal. Frighten one creature. Costs 1 WIL.

items.name: Crew ID Badge
items.description: Opens some doors. The photo doesn't look like you.

items.name: Mirror Shard
items.description: Broken bathroom mirror. Reflects light. Cuts fingers.

items.name: Captain's Flask
items.description: Still half-full of whiskey. Monsters find the smell interesting.

overturned_tables: Tables and chairs are heaped against the far wall, smeared with something dark.
The mess hall furniture has been barricaded — from the inside.
Trays of fossilized food litter the floor. The tables are on their sides.
dangling_cables: Cables hang from the ceiling like black intestines.
A web of severed wiring sparks and twitches in the dark.
You push through hanging cables. Some of them are warm.
shipping_containers: Massive shipping containers are stacked in the dark, some torn open.
The containers have been rearranged into a kind of nest.
Cargo crates block every sightline. Something moves between them.
surgical_trays: Surgical instruments are laid out with disturbing precision.
The operating table is occupied. The straps are broken from the inside.
Scalpels, saws, and things with no medical name cover every surface.
broken_tanks: Glass specimen tanks line the walls, most shattered. The contents are gone.
Preservation fluid pools on the floor. The things it preserved are missing.
A tank in the corner is still sealed. Something inside is watching you.
blast_door: A blast door has been forced halfway open. The metal is bent outward.
Emergency bulkheads have sealed the corridor. The override panel flickers.
The door is dented from the other side. Whatever hit it hit it many times.

scratching: Something scratches at the walls. Rhythmic. Patient.
Fingernails — or what used to be fingernails — scrape along metal.
A dry, persistent scratching comes from inside the ventilation ducts.
dripping: A thick, slow drip echoes through the shaft. It's not water.
Something viscous drips from above. It's warm.
Drip. Drip. Drip. The rhythm is too regular to be mechanical.
hissing: Gas hisses from a ruptured cryo pod.
A long, wet hiss from the dark ahead. Not a pipe.
Steam or something worse leaks from the walls.
groaning_metal: The hull groans under stresses it was never meant to bear.
Metal screams somewhere deep in the ship's bones.
The walls shift. The ship is slowly crushing itself.
silence: The silence here is absolute. Not even the ship's heartbeat reaches this place.
Nothing. No hum, no vibration. The ship is dead here.
The quiet is wrong. Ships are never this quiet.
thrumming: A deep, subsonic thrum vibrates through the floor.
The reactor is still running. You can feel it in your teeth.
A rhythmic pulse of energy. The engine doesn't know the crew is dead.
whispering: The servers are whispering. It sounds like names.
Static resolves into almost-words. Almost your name.
A voice from the speakers, too quiet to understand, too clear to ignore.
alarm: A klaxon wails in stuttering bursts. It's been going for days.
Red alert. The alarm has worn itself hoarse.
The alarm screams, stops, screams again. Like breathing.
heartbeat: A wet, organic pulse throbs through the bridge. It's not a machine.
You feel it in the floor, the walls, the air. A heartbeat. The ship's new heartbeat.
Thud. Thud. Thud. Something alive in a place where nothing should be.

emergency_red: Red emergency lights strobe in slow, sick pulses.
Everything is bathed in deep red. Blood-colored light.
The emergency lighting turns the corridor into something from a nightmare.
flickering: Fluorescent panels flicker overhead, strobing shadows across the walls.
The lights are dying. Each flicker shows a different arrangement of shadows.
On. Off. On. Off. You see more in the dark than you want to.
bioluminescent: Pale green light pulses from organic growths on the walls.
Something is growing here. It glows. It shouldn't exist.
Luminous tendrils spread across the ceiling like diseased veins.
surgical: Harsh white surgical light illuminates everything mercilessly.
The examination light is still on. It illuminates an empty, stained table.
Under this light, you can see too much detail.
blue_glow: Cryo chambers glow ice-blue. Most are open. Some are not.
A cold blue radiance fills the room. It's almost peaceful.
The blue light makes everything look frozen. Some of it is.
starlight: Through the viewport, stars burn in the infinite black.
The galaxy spills across the window. You are very, very far from home.
Starlight pours in. It's beautiful. It's also the only light for light-years.
monitor_glow: Screens flicker with data that shouldn't still be updating.
Green text scrolls endlessly. Status reports from a dead ship.
The monitors cast a sickly glow. One of them is showing camera feeds.
candle: Someone lit candles here. Recently. With human hands.
Wax pools on the deck plating. This was done with intention.
Candles flicker on an improvised altar. Who's still alive to light them?
pulsing: A deep, organic pulse of light throbs from the center of the bridge.
Light moves through the walls like blood through veins.
The glow brightens and dims in rhythm with the heartbeat.

decay: The air is thick with the sweetness of decomposition.
Something dead. Something recently dead. The cold only slows it.
The smell hits you before you see the source.
rot: Wet, black rot. The kind that gets into your clothes.
Biological decay. Advanced. The recyclers have been off for weeks.
It smells like a body left in a warm room. Several bodies.
antiseptic: Sterile. Chemical clean. It doesn't belong here anymore.
The sharp bite of disinfectant. As if cleanliness could help.
Alcohol and iodine. The med bay remembers what it used to be.
ozone: The tang of ozone burns your nostrils. Something electrical is very wrong.
Ionized air. The reactor is leaking energy.
It smells like a lightning strike in a closed room.
formaldehyde: The sharp, clinging smell of formaldehyde and something worse beneath it.
Specimen fluid. Decades of collected samples, now free.
vegetal: Chlorophyll and wet earth. The hydroponics have gone feral.
Something is growing wild. The smell is green and wrong.
Plants that were engineered to feed the crew are feeding on something else now.
incense: Incense. Someone is burning incense on a dead ship.
A sweet, smoky scent that doesn't belong in space.
The chapel still smells holy. That makes it worse.

claustrophobic: The walls are too close. The ceiling is too low. The ship is pressing in.
Every surface hums with the vibration of a dying vessel.
Personal effects float in zero-g pockets. Someone lived here. Someone doesn't anymore.
tight: You can barely fit. The shaft wasn't designed for someone moving this fast.
Shoulders scrape both walls. If something comes from ahead, there's no room to swing.
Crawling. On your belly. In the dark. Inside a dead ship.
humid: The air is thick and wet and warm. Nothing should be warm on this ship.
Condensation drips from every surface. The air tastes alive.
Tropical heat in a metal coffin. The plants have won this room.
vast: The cargo hold stretches into darkness. Your light doesn't reach the far wall.
Echoes return from too far away. This room is enormous.
You feel exposed. Open space on a ship is a vulnerability.
freezing: The cold here is absolute. Your breath crystallizes instantly.
Cryo-level temperatures. The pods are still cycling. Some are occupied.
Ice crystals hang in the air like frozen dust. Beautiful. Deathly.
vertigo: The viewport shows nothing but void in every direction. You grip the railing.
Stars wheel slowly past the glass. The ship is tumbling.
Looking down through the observation window, you see infinity.
heat: The reactor bleeds heat into the walls. The air shimmers.
Sweat beads instantly. The engine room is an oven.
The heat is alive here. It pushes against you.
electric: The air crackles with static. Your hair stands on end.
Sparks jump between surfaces. The server core is overloaded.
You can taste copper. The electromagnetic field is dangerously strong.
decompression: The air is thin here. Your ears pop. Somewhere, a seal is failing.
A faint whistle of escaping atmosphere. The hull is compromised.
Every breath takes effort. The ship is bleeding air.
dread: Every instinct says turn back. The ship agrees.
Something is aware of you. The walls know your name.
You are not alone. You have not been alone since you woke up.
